How Meet Bundle collects, uses and protects your information when you use the Bundle dating app and website.
Bundle is a dating app run by Meet Bundle (“we”, “us”). This policy explains what we collect, why, and the choices you have.
To create and secure your account
First name, birthday, gender, who you want to meet, photos, interests, optional answers such as orientation, relationship status, languages and About me
To show your profile and suggest people
Your city, and your device location if you allow it
To show people near you. Others see your city and an approximate distance, never your exact location.
Likes, Winks, Sparks, passes, matches and messages
Device type, app version, notification token
To send notifications and fix problems
Your birthday is used to show your age; it is never shown on your profile. Some answers, such as orientation, are sensitive. They are always optional, and you can remove them at any time.
Show your profile to people who match your preferences, and theirs to you.
Review photos before others see them, and act on reports.
Send notifications you’ve agreed to, such as new Likes, matches and messages.
Keep accounts secure and prevent fraud and abuse.
Understand how the website is used, with cookie-free analytics.
We don’t sell your personal information, and we don’t use it for third-party advertising.

Other members see your profile: name, age, city, photos, interests and any answers you choose to add. Your messages are visible only to you and the person you’re talking to, except when a message is reported and reviewed for safety.
We share data only with service providers who help us run Bundle, such as hosting, email delivery and photo moderation, under contracts that limit how they use it, or when the law requires it.

We keep your data while your account is open. When you delete your account, we delete your profile, photos, matches and messages, except safety records kept for up to 12 months and records the law requires.

Bundle’s standards against child sexual abuse and exploitation (CSAE), how to report concerns, and how Meet Bundle responds.

Bundle is a dating app for adults, run by Meet Bundle. We have zero tolerance for child sexual abuse and exploitation (CSAE), including child sexual abuse material (CSAM). This page sets out our standards and how to report a concern.
Bundle is for people aged 18 and over. Everyone must give a date of birth when they join, and anyone under 18 is blocked from creating an account.
We prohibit any content or behavior that sexualizes, exploits or endangers minors. That includes CSAM, grooming, sexual solicitation of a minor, sextortion, and trafficking.
Profile photos and messages must not show or refer to minors in any sexual or exploitative way.
These standards apply to every user, every profile, every photo and every message.
Every photo is reviewed before other members can see it. Photos that break our rules are rejected and the account can be restricted.
We collect date of birth at sign-up and remove accounts we learn belong to anyone under 18.
Every profile and chat has Report and Block options.
Our team reviews reports, prioritizing child safety reports above all others.
We can restrict an account at any time while we investigate.
Open the person’s profile, or your chat with them.
Tap the menu (⋮) and choose Report.
Choose the reason that fits best and add any details.
Email us with the subject “Child safety”:
Include the person’s name as shown on Bundle and what you saw. Please don’t send us images of the abuse. Describe it instead.
If a child is in immediate danger
Contact your local emergency services or police first. In Israel, call 100.

We review child safety reports as our highest priority.
We remove violating content and permanently ban the accounts involved.
We preserve relevant information as required by law to support investigations.

We report confirmed CSAM and child exploitation to the relevant authorities, including the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC) and law enforcement in the relevant country, as the law requires.
We cooperate with law enforcement requests made through proper legal channels.
Meet Bundle complies with applicable child safety laws in the countries where Bundle is available, and with Google Play’s and Apple’s child safety requirements.

What’s the difference between a Wink, a Like and a Spark?
A Wink is a light hello. A Like says you’re interested, and if they like you back, it’s a match. A Spark is a Like with a message.
